claim_card.quantifiers: Every type E with NormedAddCommGroup, NormedSpace Complex, compatible NormedSpace Real, IsScalarTower Real Complex E, CompleteSpace; every finite IntegralCycle Gamma, Delta; every open U : Set Complex; every f : Complex -> E differentiableOn Complex f U.
claim_card.hypotheses: Gamma.trace subset U; Delta.trace subset U; for all w not in U, winding Gamma w = winding Delta w.
claim_card.representation: IntegralCycle contains an arbitrary finite family of actual interval-integrable Complex velocities v_i, bases, and equations integral_0^1 v_i = 0. curve_i(s)=base_i+integral_0^s v_i; lineIntegral f=sum_i integral_0^1 v_i(s) smul f(curve_i(s)).
claim_card.winding: Complex-valued normalized analytic integral (2*pi*I)^(-1) * lineIntegral(z -> (z-w)^(-1)). Its geometric use here is only off the trace, guaranteed outside U by trace containment; no integer-valued hypothesis is used.
claim_card.domain_and_exceptions: U may be disconnected, nonconvex, unbounded, empty or all Complex. Cycles may be empty, constant, repeated, reversed, self-intersecting or non-piecewise-smooth. Target E may be zero-dimensional or infinite-dimensional. Data outside U and curve extensions outside [0,1] are arbitrary.

normalized_objects.dslope: dslope f w z=(z-w)^(-1) smul (f z-f w) when z != w, and deriv_Complex f w when z=w.
normalized_objects.pairDixon: If w in U, H1_Gamma(w)-H1_Delta(w); otherwise H2_Gamma(w)-H2_Delta(w).
normalized_objects.off_trace_identity: H1_Gamma(w)=H2_Gamma(w)-K_Gamma(w) smul f(w), where K_Gamma(w)=Gamma.lineIntegral(z -> (z-w)^(-1)). Equal analytic winding implies equal K because the Cauchy prefactor is nonzero.

obligations.name: Actual arbitrary integrable velocities
obligations.evidence: Dominating function at curve i is norm(velocity_i(t))*M, interval integrable from the defining field. Neither velocity pointwise bounds nor C1 curves are assumed.

obligations.name: Parameter differentiation measurability and derivative inputs
obligations.evidence: For every nearby parameter, continuous trace density gives integrable line integrand and AE strong measurability; derivative density is continuous at the target parameter; derivative bound and chain scalar multiplication hold for every curve point. Pinned theorem requires exactly these hypotheses.

obligations.name: H1 arbitrary open domain and diagonal
obligations.evidence: Convex tubes are used only locally near diagonal; off-diagonal quotient continuity applies on general U. Separate fixed-node holomorphy includes the diagonal through pinned removable-singularity theorem. Compact trace times a closed parameter ball gives finite uniform Cauchy bound.

obligations.name: Standalone two-variable dslope holomorphy
obligations.evidence: Source proves joint continuity, required partial holomorphy, derivative continuity and compact uniformity. No two-variable DifferentiableOn theorem is stated or needed for the final claim.

obligations.name: H2 derivative kernel sign and separation
obligations.evidence: Derivative in w of (z-w)^(-1) is +(z-w)^(-2). exists_ball_away_trace yields epsilon <= norm(z-w_prime) for every trace point and every parameter in one neighborhood.

obligations.name: H2 decay
obligations.evidence: norm(H2(w)) <= length(Gamma)*M/(norm(w)-R) for norm(w)>R; compactness supplies R,M; cocompact norm tails imply convergence to zero. No finite-dimensionality of target used.

obligations.name: Winding local constancy and infinity
obligations.evidence: Derivative of winding vanishes by exact scalar primitive integral cancellation. At large w, inverse kernel has a primitive on a ball containing trace, so winding is exactly zero eventually. No integrality premise or circular general Cauchy comparison is used.

obligations.name: hmatch helper premise discharged concretely
obligations.evidence: pairDixon_eq_zero invokes pairH1H2match from continuous densities, off-trace membership and equal winding; it also supplies both off-trace/winding-zero tails and both decay limits internally. Final lineIntegral_eq_of_winding has no hmatch/decay/continuation-zero premises.

obligations.name: Boundary glue outside U including boundary points
obligations.evidence: At w not in U both traces avoid w. In a common neighborhood winding of each cycle is its value at w and both traces are avoided. At a nearby point inside U, outside-U equality at the original w plus local constancy yields matching; outside U piece equality is definitional. Thus continuation agrees locally with holomorphic H2 difference at every such w.

obligations.name: Trace points inside U
obligations.evidence: Trace points belong to open U, where continuation is locally H1 difference and diagonal dslope has its derivative value. No off-trace assumption enters this branch.

obligations.name: Liouville and zero-dimensional target
obligations.evidence: Pinned Differentiable.apply_eq_of_tendsto_cocompact is Banach-valued and imposes Nontrivial only on its domain. Here domain is Complex, so no Nontrivial E or finite-dimensional target assumption is required.

obligations.name: Twist extraction including w on trace
obligations.evidence: For z != w quotient cancels (z-w); at z=w product derivative is 1 smul f(w)+0 smul f_prime(w)=f(w). Therefore dslope_twist_eq holds for all z and the chosen w in U may lie on either trace.

obligations.name: Empty U
obligations.evidence: Separate branch bounds each line-integral norm by length*0 using the impossible trace-membership premise, then deduces integral zero. No arbitrary point of empty U is selected.

obligations.name: Empty cycles / constants / repeated or reversed loops / arbitrary overlap
obligations.evidence: All proofs quantify over finite index occurrences without positive-count, nonconstant, injective, disjoint or orientation-sign restrictions. Repeats remain in sums and normalized winding.

obligations.name: Topological winding integrality or equivalence with another external contour representation
obligations.evidence: The theorem uses the explicitly defined normalized analytic winding for IntegralCycle. Its relation to original RS contours requires the separately audited representation bridge.

decisive_branch_reconstruction.boundary: a near w outside U: winding_Gamma(a)=winding_Gamma(w)=winding_Delta(w)=winding_Delta(a), and a avoids both traces. If a in U apply algebraic pair match; otherwise piecewise equality is rfl.
decisive_branch_reconstruction.infinity: Outside a sufficiently large compact set both windings are zero and both traces avoided. Pair matching then identifies inside-U H1 values with H2 values as well, so the whole continuation has the H2 difference limit 0 even when U is unbounded.
decisive_branch_reconstruction.twist: Apply the concrete zero-continuation theorem to g(z)=(z-w) smul f(z). Its U-branch at w is the difference of the original integrals, because dslope g w z=f(z) for every z.
